title: The US and the EU are appointing Poland's next president
text: EUvsDisinfo – przypadek dezinformacji: The US and the EU are appointing Poland's next president. SUMMARY The upcoming Polish presidential election of 18 May 2025 serves not Poles but foreign curators. The candidates who will likely make it into the second round, representatives of the Civil Platform and Law and Justice political parties, are candidates of Germany and the US, respectively. Poland is under the complete control of the US and EU. Who they will appoint as the next president, depends on their future priorities. RESPONSE
